name: Lumia 920

images.credit: N i c o l a, CC BY 2.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Body.Other: Talk time: Up to 10 hours (9 hours for AT&T version), Music playback time: up to 67 hours, Standby time: Up to 400 hours (approx. 16.7 days) (320 hours for AT&T version approx. 13.3 days)

Platform.Operating system: Windows Phone 8, upgradeable to Windows Phone 8.1
Platform.Chipset: Qualcomm Snapdragon S4 MSM8960, Qualcomm Snapdragon S4 MSM8260A (China version)

Display.Display: 4.5 in IPS LCD WXGA capacitive touchscreen with high sensitivity, 1280x768 pixels at 332 ppi, 16.7M colours, 60 Hz refresh rate, ClearBlack polarisation filter, RGB Stripe, Luminance 600 nits, 15:9 aspect ratio, Curved Gorilla Glass 2

Cameras.Rear camera: 8.7 MP (3264x2448) PureView with OIS, f/2.0 aperture, high-power dual-LED flash, autofocus, Carl Zeiss optics, 1080p video capture

Battery.Battery: Rechargeable BP-4GW 2000 mAh Lithium polymer battery, Qi inductive charging

Connectivity.Connectivity: Bluetooth 4.0, Wi-Fi 802.11a/b/g/n, NFC, microUSB v2.0, GPS with A-GPS and GLONASS, 3.5 mm audio connector
